name: Amprion
desc: German transmission system operator running an 11,000 km high-voltage grid in western Germany and building new HVDC and offshore links.
products: Electricity transmission, grid expansion, offshore grid connections, interconnectors
customers: Distribution grid operators, generators, industrial users, electricity market
parent_immediate: M31 Beteiligungsgesellschaft mbH & Co. Energie KG (74.9%)
parent_ultimate: Consortium of supply utilities and German institutional investors (M31); RWE/Apollo JV RWE Alkaios holds 25.1%
minority_investors: RWE Alkaios Holding GmbH (JV of RWE AG and Apollo Global Management) 25.1%
parent_backing: Shareholders injected EUR 850m equity (Dec 2024) and EUR 2.2bn equity (Dec 2025): https://www.amprion.net/Investor-Relations/News-Meldungen/
markets: Western Germany (North Rhine-Westphalia, Lower Saxony, Hesse, Rhineland-Palatinate, Saarland, Bavaria parts); interconnectors to Belgium
expansion_markets: 9,300 km of new or upgraded lines; EUR 36.4bn investment plan to 2029
profitability_basis: Adjusted group result up 19% to EUR 343m in H1 2026 (press release 20.08.2026)

signals.what: Apollo Global Management enters via RWE Alkaios (announced)
Katrin Hilmer appointed to management board

fit_rationale: Spends billions a year with cable, converter and engineering suppliers (Prysmian, Hitachi Energy, Siemens Energy, NKT, Sumitomo Electric); hospitality could serve supplier and investor relations, but it has no consumer brand and one home market.
f1_markets: none directly (Germany not on calendar); Belgium interconnector

access.roles: Head of Communications; CFO / investor relations

outstanding: Annual revenue figure not opened; regulated TSO, sponsorship appetite unproven
